baseline.truth_writer_note: MOD-05 creates no official truth writer; the existing Simulation Core truth boundary remains protected and unchanged.

lanes.purpose: Own the current JSON mainline integration boundary, shared contracts, API/server coordination, test and CI coordination, and serial merge control without becoming a new truth writer.
lanes.workspace_rule: Use one isolated linked worktree and one exact file allowlist per mission; never share a runtime store, database, port, provider selector, or lockfile with another lane.
forbidden_truth_mutations: provider activation or external model calls

lanes.purpose: Prepare Shanghai and eldercare scenario or plugin candidates as bounded inputs to the current core path; SH is not a formal truth writer.
lanes.workspace_rule: Use a dedicated SH worktree with an exact scenario/plugin allowlist; consume current contracts and source read-only and never share mutable runtime state with MAIN, MOD, AGT, or FE.
forbidden_truth_mutations: direct writes to market, operations, finance, scoring, or enterprise state
provider activation or external model calls

lanes.purpose: Prepare model research, registry, comparison, and evidence candidates for offline or shadow use; MOD output remains candidate input and never becomes runtime authority.
lanes.workspace_rule: Use a dedicated MOD worktree with an exact research/evidence allowlist; use official primary sources only where research is authorized and keep all model candidates provider-off and non-deploying.
forbidden_truth_mutations: provider activation, dependency activation, or real-model calls
model registry promotion to runtime authority

lanes.purpose: Own the existing Agent Gateway and advisory-only boundary for schema-validated candidate or advisory output and audit inputs; AGT cannot write formal truth.
lanes.workspace_rule: Use a dedicated AGT worktree with an exact gateway/advisory allowlist; provider selector stays off, runtime stores stay isolated, and API/core/contract authority is read-only unless separately assigned.
forbidden_truth_mutations: official Simulation Core or Enterprise State writer
direct API/database writes outside the advisory boundary
provider activation or external model calls

lanes.purpose: Own teacher, student, and shared UI presentation and interaction surfaces that consume structured contracts, safe projections, and advisory explanations.
lanes.workspace_rule: Use a dedicated FE worktree with an exact UI allowlist; FE consumes API projections and explanations and never computes or persists official outcomes.
forbidden_truth_mutations: official Simulation Core or API truth-writer topology
client-side official market, finance, scoring, ranking, or settlement calculation
provider activation or external model calls

dependency_graph.description: SH reads current API, shared-contract, simulation, and governance boundaries before preparing scenario/plugin candidates.
MOD reads the current source baseline and contracts before preparing research or registry candidates.
AGT reads the current actor, tenant, schema, audit, and truth-protection boundaries.
FE reads current shared contracts and API projection boundaries.
Scenario and plugin candidates are reviewed inputs only; MAIN remains the controlled integration path.
Offline model research may inform bounded scenario analysis without activating a model or changing scenario truth.
Model metadata and research candidates may be consumed by advisory-only work after contract and authority checks.
AGT exposes only schema-validated advisory or candidate output for UI display.
FE consumes structured result and explanation projections and does not calculate official outcomes.
MAIN controls cross-track conflict review and serial Join admission for SH.
MAIN controls evidence review and serial Join admission for MOD.
MAIN controls advisory-boundary conflict review and serial Join admission for AGT.
MAIN controls UI contract conflict review and serial Join admission for FE.

mission_start_contract.worktree: A dedicated isolated linked worktree for one lane and one mission; no dirty or shared writer state may be adopted implicitly.
tests: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='docs/evidence/mod-05-parallelism-20260822/parallelism-join-manifest.json'; const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); if(x.status!=='PARALLELISM_QUALIFIED') throw new Error('wrong gate'); if(x.baseline.master_sha!=='1fbe6eec73c0d234023549834f86c9c1f4d6b8d8') throw new Error('wrong baseline'); if(x.lanes.length!==5) throw new Error('wrong lane count'); if(x.resource_owners.some(r=>!r.owner||!r.lock_mode||!r.release_condition||!r.expiry)) throw new Error('incomplete lock'); console.log('MOD-05 manifest PASS')"
mission_start_contract.ports: NONE_FOR_TASK_1; any future lane must reserve a unique port and may not share a running service.
mission_start_contract.runtime_store: NO_RUNTIME_START; JSON_INTERNAL_ONLY baseline; any future validation uses an isolated memory or task-local JSON store and never the shared development snapshot.
mission_start_contract.provider_selector: PROVIDER_OFF; provider_calls must remain 0; no implicit latest/current selector and no dependency installation or upgrade.

merge_barrier.cross_track_conflict_scan: REQUIRED; compare every lane diff and path claim against the current source SHA and all resource owners before Join.
merge_barrier.focused_validation: REQUIRED for each lane's exact allowlist; a passing manifest parse does not substitute for lane-specific validation.
merge_barrier.exact_head_ci: REQUIRED; CI must run against the exact candidate head and be read back before serial merge.
merge_barrier.evidence_review: REQUIRED; review source identity, lock ownership, non-proofs, and truth/provider boundaries.
merge_barrier.post_merge_fresh_readback: REQUIRED; re-read master, merged head, changed paths, required checks, and lock validity after merge.
stop_conditions: truth, provider, database, or runtime-authority boundary change

required_evidence: ports, runtime store, provider selector, and expiry declarations
no shared runtime or port collision
required CI check results at that SHA
no pending required check treated as pass
one ready PR at a time

allowed: Close an unmerged branch or PR without deleting unrelated work.
Revert a merged change with a new reviewable revert commit.
Use a recoverable branch/PR closure path and preserve the evidence receipt.
forbidden: git reset --hard as a rollback mechanism
destructive deletion or overwrite of another lane's files
rollback_policy.truth_boundary: Rollback must not rewrite historical official results, replay truth, audit evidence, or another owner's work.

expiry_policy.rule: An expired lock pauses its lane, invalidates pending Join evidence, and requires portfolio and lock recompilation before any restart.
triggers: owner, path, mission, port, provider, or runtime-store declaration changes
a second writer or unregistered worktree is detected
a required check or evidence receipt becomes stale
